known_evidence: The investigators and agents know all prior exploratory results through 2026. No pristine holdout or independent team is claimed.

normalization.method: empirical midrank against prior calendar months only
normalization.window_comparison_minimum: full window of valid observations; common dates reported separately from base

candidates.v2: Frozen prior daily four-source scalar sampled at last complete daily row each month; native horizon retained and documented
candidates.equal_family: Equal mean of market, confidence and 100-friction; equal component weights within family
candidates.panel6: Previous six profiles, no single headline; complete components required
candidates.dt905_adapted: Fixed-development PCA of seven BDE channels, then development-empirical percentile; oriented in development toward tighter conditions. Adaptation, not replication
candidates.minimal3: Market, confidence and bank financing spread profile; equal weights in first two; no aggregate

pca.standardization: training mean/std only; real10 uses monthly rate level, others use research feature definitions
pca.correlation_filter: abs Pearson >0.8 on development: retain earlier declared feature

external_economic_test.estimator: ridge alpha10; train-only z-scales; quarterly mean of complete monthly rows; all alternatives evaluated on same quarters
external_economic_test.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap, 400 draws, blocks4quarters, 99.167% interval per target for six targets; no causal interpretation
external_economic_test.accept: 10% MAE gain over controls on >=2 targets including supply and demand, gain interval lower >0; superiority over simplest competent alternative must also have positive paired interval
external_economic_test.forbidden: ECB association is not a criterion truth for psychological fear/greed; a failed ridge cannot refute all economic information

diagnostic_tasks.kind: automated information-preservation controls, not human or independent construct validation
tasks: recover family category and >5-point month change
distinguish zero ECB balance with opposing responses from all unchanged
diagnostic_tasks.decoder: train-only ridge alpha10 from each representation to family diagnostic reference; directly displayed coordinates are read directly; test on common dates
diagnostic_tasks.aggregation_reject: error >10% in either category or opposition task, or inability to identify source without showing its decomposition
diagnostic_tasks.fairness: Any scalar plus the same decomposed dashboard can solve those tasks; that is information of the dashboard, not the scalar

stability.windows: change of reference horizon, reported as interpretation dependence; not equivalent economic questions
stability.ablation: leave one component or family, intentional equal reweighting only for that alternative; missingness never reweighted
stability.missingness: one missing component => missing mandatory profile; always show missing source
stability.extremes: single historical component replaced by median+8MAD, before test; current genuine extremes expected to alter diagnosis
stability.revision_scenarios: +/-0.25 development MAD in each feature, hypothetical not observed revisions
stability.lag_scope: uniform and asymmetric family delays; not historical availability reconstruction
stability.range_abstention: Report base60 + full-window36/60/120 envelope where available. Categorical description only if all ranks in same category and width<=20. No label without all three horizons; numerical values remain identified by horizon
stability.rank_metric: Spearman on common months; cannot override category/opposite-tail failures

dynamic_gate.question: Is persistent disagreement a stable dynamic result rather than normalization memory?
dynamic_gate.sindy_library: discrete-time degree2: constant+3states+6quadratics=10 terms per equation
dynamic_gate.if_fail: Do not fit SINDy; report failure of identifiability gate. Run persistence and ridge VAR1 only as diagnostic forecasting benchmarks, not financial forecasts

selection.rule: Fewest mandatory inputs among methods passing relevant essential gates; scalar construct failure forbids fear/greed naming regardless of software. If no scalar passes, keep a descriptive panel with explicit limitations; if stable-label coverage fails, no confident standardized headline. Human usability remains untested without actual participants.
selection.fear_greed_gate: Independent discriminant evidence about risk-taking preferences net of fundamentals is indispensable; mere prices/credit/confidence or their correlations do not identify that construct
selection.novelty_gate: A bounded search can refute broad novelty claims but cannot establish global priority. Claim only a verified technical/descriptive contribution.
